name: Frozen-poison gradient-consistency lambda sweep
controls: Lambda zero uses the same concatenated original/jittered views and BatchNorm statistics as the other sweep settings. The standard baseline remains single-view training.
fixed: Identical 25 saved poison tensors, victim seeds, 60-epoch training, augmentation draws, CIFAR10 balanced 10k train / full 10k test, ResNet20, jitter radius32/255.
interpretation: Exploratory hyperparameter sweep on the existing three fixed target images. Do not interpret the best test result as held-out evidence; a selected lambda needs new independent target/poison runs. Fixed standard-attack poisons; not a defense-adaptive evaluation.
execution: Ten sequential Slurm array tasks, each with persistent tmux and an srun-managed GPU worker, 25 models per task. Independent tasks allow other lambda values to run if a setting fails.
